PG.eligibility: case-sensitive POSIX basename against primary filenames with Python fnmatchcase
PG.keys: all primary filename patterns per class ID
PG.preference: a matching literal pattern contains none of * ? [
PG.ties: all IDs with maximal numeric score in Unicode code-point order

TZ.eligibility: exact uppercase two-letter country token in comma-separated country column
TZ.keys: all ordered country tokens per timezone ID
TZ.preference: requested token is first in country column
TZ.ties: all IDs with maximal numeric score in Unicode code-point order
